mapper.select: SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.psp_id AS pspId, a.id AS pspAccountId, p.psp_code AS pspCode, a.api_secret AS apiSecret FROM psp_account a INNER JOIN psp_provider p ON p.id = a.psp_id WHERE a.psp_account_no = #{pspAccountNo} AND a.status = 1 AND p.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.psp_id AS pspId, p.psp_code AS pspCode, p.base_url AS pspBaseUrl, p.config_json AS providerConfigJson, a.id AS pspAccountId, a.psp_account_no AS pspAccountNo, a.api_key AS apiKey, a.api_secret AS apiSecret, a.config_json AS accountConfigJson FROM psp_account a INNER JOIN psp_provider p ON p.id = a.psp_id WHERE a.id = #{pspAccountId} AND a.status = 1 AND p.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.psp_id AS pspId, p.psp_code AS pspCode, p.base_url AS pspBaseUrl, p.config_json AS providerConfigJson, a.id AS pspAccountId, a.psp_account_no AS pspAccountNo, a.api_key AS apiKey, a.api_secret AS apiSecret, a.config_json AS accountConfigJson FROM psp_account a INNER JOIN psp_provider p ON p.id = a.psp_id WHERE a.status = 1 AND p.status = 1
